## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and the tests for what I touched pass (`pnpm test` for the whole suite)
- [ ] `pnpm check:i18n` passes (no hard-coded text outside the language catalogs)
- [ ] User-facing text is in both languages, and the README/guide is updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths or generated media committed
